description: Source code for the ContentsDriver class in OrchardCore, handling content display and editing logic including permissions and shape alternates.

classes.name: ContentsDriver
classes.description: A sealed class extending ContentDisplayDriver, managing content display and editing with custom shapes and permission checks.

methods.name: DisplayAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously builds the display shape for a content item, adding custom alternates and action buttons based on permissions.

methods.name: EditAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously builds the edit interface for a content item, including publish, unpublish, save draft, and delete buttons with permission checks.
